# Post-hoc calibration test

Accuracy / ECE (10 bins) before → after one calibrator per slice, 2-fold cross-fitted by family (`eval/jevbench/calibrate.py`). Choice slices use a temperature, which never changes the answer; yes/no slices use Platt scaling (scale + bias on the log-odds), which can move the yes/no threshold. Probabilities are kept at full precision. Score (ordinal) slices are excluded.
